# 1. Stats

```{r}
####
# BIOL 499 Script 3: Just Trait Analysis 
# Last Updated: March 5, 2026
# Description: determine if microsites (biocrusts and cow pats) act as selective 
# filters based on functional traits like seed mass, length, and shape.
# Notes: find better data for seed mass; maybe drop seed length
```

## Data Prep

```{r}
seedlingdf <- read.csv(here("6_manualediting", "gc_seedtraitsfinal.csv"))
gcseedling <- read.csv(here("5_outputtables", "gc_wcategories.csv"))

seedlingdf_clean <- seedlingdf %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ na_if(as.character(.), "n/a"))) %>%
  mutate(final_mass = as.numeric(final_mass),
         final_length = as.numeric(final_length))

merged_seedling_traits <- gcseedling %>%
  left_join(seedlingdf_clean, by = c("Species" = "Species")) %>% 
  filter(microsite_condition != "double_control") %>% 
  mutate(
    surface_depth = case_match(surface_depth, 
                               "10-May" ~ "5-10", 
                               .default = surface_depth),
    surface_depth = factor(surface_depth, levels = c("surface", "0-5", "5-10")),
    microsite_condition = factor(microsite_condition, levels = c("biocrust", "dung", "control"))
  )
```

## Descriptive stats

### Group level stats

```{r}
trait_descriptive_stats <- merged_seedling_traits %>%
  group_by(microsite_condition, surface_depth) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_mass = mean(final_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_mass = sd(final_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_length = mean(final_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_length = sd(final_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_seedlings = n(), .groups = "drop"
  )

```

## Tests

### Community weighted means (CWMs)

```{r}
cwm_tray <- merged_seedling_traits %>%
  group_by(Tray.., site, microsite_condition, surface_depth) %>%
  summarise(cwm_mass = mean(final_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
            cwm_length = mean(final_length, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

### KS test

```{r}
# KS Test for mass (Variety Clumping)
dung_mass_dist <- merged_seedling_traits %>% filter(microsite_condition == "dung") %>% pull(final_mass) %>% na.omit()
biocrust_mass_dist <- merged_seedling_traits %>% filter(microsite_condition == "biocrust") %>% pull(final_mass) %>% na.omit()
ks_result_mass <- ks.test(dung_mass_dist, biocrust_mass_dist)
```

### GLMM mass

```{r}
# clean 
treatment_levels <- c(
  "biocrust_surface", "dung_surface",
  "control_0-5",      "biocrust_0-5",     "dung_0-5",
  "control_5-10",     "biocrust_5-10",    "dung_5-10"
)

merged_seedling_traits <- merged_seedling_traits %>%
  mutate(
    # Create the same treatment strings as your abundance model
    treatment = paste(microsite_condition, surface_depth, sep = "_"),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = treatment_levels),
    site = factor(site),
    Tray.. = factor(Tray..)
  )

#model_mass <- lmer(final_mass ~ microsite_condition * surface_depth + (1 | site/tray), data = merged_seedling_traits)
#model_length <- lmer(final_length ~ microsite_condition * surface_depth + (1 | site/tray), data = merged_seedling_traits)
model_mass <- glmmTMB(final_mass ~ treatment + (1 | site/Tray..), 
                          data = merged_seedling_traits, 
                          family = Gamma(link = "log"))
summary(model_mass)
Anova(model_mass, type = "III")
      
# Simple Models (Microsite only)
#model_mass_micro <- lmer(final_mass ~ microsite_condition + (1 | site/Tray..), data = #merged_seedling_traits)
#model_length_micro <- lmer(final_length ~ microsite_condition + (1 | site/tray), data = merged_seedling_traits)
```

# 3. Visualization

### Coefficient of variation + plot

```{r}
cv_summary <- trait_descriptive_stats %>%
  mutate(cv_mass = (sd_mass / mean_mass) * 100)

cv_long <- cv_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(cv_mass), 
               names_to = "trait", 
               values_to = "cv") %>%
  
  mutate(trait = case_match(trait,
                            "cv_mass" ~ "Mass CV (%)"))

ggplot(cv_long, aes(x = microsite_condition, y = cv, fill = microsite_condition)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8, color = "white") +
  
  # cv values
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(cv, 1), 
                               "%\n(n=", n_seedlings, ")")), 
            vjust = -0.2,    # Adjusts height above bar
            lineheight = 0.8, # Tightens the space between the two lines
            size = 3) +
  
  # facet = use to create multiple layouts
  facet_grid(trait ~ surface_depth, scales = "fixed") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 300), 
                     breaks = seq(0, 300, 50),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("biocrust" = "#8B9E6B", 
                               "dung" = "#C4944A", 
                               "control" = "#D4C09A")) +
  
  # graph labels
  labs(y = "Coefficient of Variation (%)", 
       fill = "Microsite", 
       x = NULL) +
  
  # theme
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),   # Hides labels since colors/legend tell the story
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

```

### Raw Trait Boxplots ----

```{r}
ggplot(merged_seedling_traits, aes(x = microsite_condition, y = final_mass, fill = microsite_condition)) +
  
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.25) +

  # facet

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("biocrust" = "#8B9E6B", "dung" = "#C4944A", "control" = "#D4C09A")) +
  
  # labels

       x = NULL, 
       fill = "Microsite",
       caption = "p = 0.56" ) +
  
  # theme
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),   # Hides labels since colors/legend tell the story
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

```

### KS density Plot

```{r}
ggplot(merged_seedling_traits %>% filter(microsite_condition %in% c("dung", "biocrust")), 
       aes(x = final_mass, fill = microsite_condition)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
           label = paste0("KS D = ", round(ks_result_mass$statistic, 3), "\np = ", round(ks_result_mass$p.value, 3))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("biocrust" = "#8B9E6B", "dung" = "#C4944A")) +
  theme_classic() + labs(x = "Seed Mass (g)", y = "Density")

```

### CWM plot

```{r}
cwm_plot_data <- cwm_tray %>%
  group_by(microsite_condition, surface_depth) %>%
  summarise(mean_cwm = mean(cwm_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_cwm = sd(cwm_mass, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(cwm_plot_data, aes(x = microsite_condition, y = mean_cwm, fill = microsite_condition)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_cwm - se_cwm, ymax = mean_cwm + se_cwm), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ surface_depth) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("biocrust" = "#8B9E6B", "dung" = "#C4944A", "control" = "#D4C09A")) +
  labs(y = "CWM Seed Mass (g)", x = NULL) +
  theme_classic() + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")


```

# Power Analysis
```{r}

# for regular power analysis; you can use pwr
# use simr for glmmTMB
library(simr)

model1 <- lmer(log(final_mass) ~ treatment + (1 | site/Tray..), 
                    data = merged_seedling_traits)


# change effect size
fixef(model1)["treatmentdung_surface"] # view effect size
fixef(model1)["treatmentdung_surface"] <- 0.22

# STIMULATE POWER
# calculate power for current treatment
powerSim(model1)

# extend model to increase sample size

# 0% power
print(power_current)

# how many seedlings would I need?
# power curve stimulates experiment until it has 80% power
model_for_curve <- lmer(log(final_mass) ~ treatment + (1 | site), 
                        data = merged_seedling_traits)

# target effect
# assume 25% is biological significant
fixef(model_for_curve)["treatmentdung_surface"] <- 0.22

# hypothetically 2000 seedings
model_ext_n <- extend(model_for_curve, within="site", n=2000)

# run the curve
plot_curve <- powerCurve(model_ext_n, 
                         fixed("treatment", "lr"), 
                         breaks = c(20, 50, 100, 200, 280, 500),
                         nsim=50)

summary(plot_curve)

plot(plot_curve)

```
